name: ecom-connect
description: FarmaHouse Demo · comercio omnicanal sobre Logic2B Ecommerce y Cloudflare

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute ecom-connect-db --local --file seed/demo.sql
scripts.catalog:import: pnpm db:migrate && node scripts/catalog/import-sql.mjs && wrangler d1 execute ecom-connect-db --local --file seed/farmahouse.sql
